-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Helper functions (security definer to avoid RLS recursion on org_members)
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
create or replace function public.is_org_member(p_org_id bigint)
returns boolean
language sql
stable
security definer
set search_path = ''
as $$
  select exists (
    select 1
    from public.org_members m
    where m.org_id = p_org_id
      and m.user_id = auth.uid()
  );
$$;

create or replace function public.is_org_admin(p_org_id bigint)
returns boolean
language sql
stable
security definer
set search_path = ''
as $$
  select exists (
    select 1
    from public.org_members m
    where m.org_id = p_org_id
      and m.user_id = auth.uid()
      and m.role = 'admin'
  );
$$;

-- Extracts the leading "<project id>" segment of a storage object path.
-- Returns null when the segment is missing or not numeric.
create or replace function public.storage_object_org_id(p_name text)
returns bigint
language plpgsql
stable
security definer
set search_path = ''
as $$
declare
  seg text;
begin
  seg := (storage.foldername(p_name))[1];
  if seg is null or seg !~ '^[0-9]+$' then
    return null;
  end if;
  return seg::bigint;
end;
$$;

set search_path = ''
as $$
begin
  return t::bigint;
exception when others then
  return null;
end;

  );
$$;

      and m.user_id = auth.uid()
  );
$$;
